result.summary: The page appears visually well-constructed overall. No critical or major visual defects were found. Only minor cosmetic/accessibility observations were noted.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') uses a light gray that may fall below recommended contrast ratios against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for small text.

issues.description: The rating '4.8 (500+)' on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar row sits on the same line as the restaurant title but appears slightly misaligned vertically with the title's baseline.
issues.suggestion: Align the rating text and star icon to the title's baseline or center them vertically within the row for a cleaner look.
